go along: Go along this street and you will see the bank on your left.
沿着这条街走,你会看到银行就在你的左边。
turn right/left: Turn left at the second crossing, and the library is just there.
在第二个路口左转,图书馆就在那儿。
spend time: I like to spend time with my family on weekends.
我喜欢在周末和家人一起度过时光。
enjoy reading: Many students enjoy reading books in the quiet library after class.
许多学生喜欢课后在安静的图书馆里读书。
of medium height: My English teacher is a young man of medium height.
我的英语老师是一位中等身高的年轻男子。
of medium build: The man of medium build is waiting for you at the gate.
那位中等身材的男子正在门口等你。
a little: Don't worry, I still have a little money in my pocket.
别担心,我口袋里还有一点钱。
differently: The two brothers think about the same problem quite differently.
这兄弟俩对同一个问题的看法大不相同。
in the end: They worked hard for months, and in the end they passed the exam.
他们努力了几个月,最后终于通过了考试。
would like: I would like a cup of coffee and some bread, please.
我想要一杯咖啡和一些面包。
take one's order: The waiter came over to take our order a few minutes later.
几分钟后服务员过来为我们点菜。
one(large)bowl of: He ate one large bowl of noodles for breakfast this morning.
今天早上他早餐吃了一大碗面条。
tofu: This soup has some tofu and vegetables in it, and it tastes great.
这道汤里有一些豆腐和蔬菜,味道很好。
around the world: People around the world love watching football games on TV.
世界各地的人们都喜欢在电视上看足球比赛。
make a wish: Close your eyes and make a wish before you blow out the candles.
吹蜡烛之前,先闭上眼睛许个愿。
blow out: He couldn't blow out all the candles on the cake at once.
他没能一下子吹灭蛋糕上所有的蜡烛。
the UK: My cousin studied in the UK for two years and learned a lot.
我表哥在英国学习了两年,学到了很多东西。
get popular: This kind of music is getting popular among young people these days.
这种音乐最近在年轻人中越来越流行。
cut up: Please help me cut up these tomatoes for the salad.
请帮我把这些西红柿切碎做沙拉。
bring good luck to…: People believe that red can bring good luck to them in the new year.
人们相信红色能在新的一年里给他们带来好运。
milk a cow: The children were excited to milk a cow for the first time.
孩子们第一次给奶牛挤奶,非常兴奋。
ride a horse: It was fun to ride a horse on the farm last summer.
去年夏天在农场骑马很有趣。
feed chickens: My uncle gets up early to feed chickens every morning.
我叔叔每天早上都早早起床喂鸡。
quite a lot(of…): We learned quite a lot of new words in this English class.
在这节英语课上我们学了相当多的新单词。
in the countryside: My grandparents live in the countryside, and the air there is fresh.
我的祖父母住在乡下,那里的空气很清新。
fire station: The new fire station is only five minutes' walk from our school.
新的消防站离我们学校步行只有五分钟。
all in all: The trip was long and tiring, but all in all we enjoyed it.
这次旅行又长又累,但总而言之我们玩得很开心。
be interested in: More and more students are interested in learning about science.
越来越多的学生对学习科学感兴趣。
stay up late: It is bad for your health to stay up late before exams.
考试前熬夜对你的健康不好。
run away: The little boy saw a big dog and began to run away.
小男孩看见一只大狗,就开始跑开了。
shout at…: It is not polite to shout at your parents when you are angry.
生气的时候冲父母大声叫嚷是不礼貌的。
woof: The dog barked at the stranger, woof woof, until he left the yard.
那条狗对着陌生人汪汪直叫,直到他离开院子。
fly a kite: It is a perfect day to fly a kite in the park.
今天是在公园里放风筝的绝佳日子。
high school: My sister will go to high school next September.
我姐姐明年九月就要上中学了。
put up: The students put up some beautiful pictures on the classroom wall.
学生们在教室墙上张贴了一些漂亮的图画。
get a surprise: We visited our teacher on her birthday and she got a big surprise.
我们在老师生日那天去看她,她吃了一大惊。
shout to…: He had to shout to his friend because the music was too loud.
因为音乐声音太大,他不得不对着朋友大声喊叫。
up and down: The little monkey jumped up and down in the tree happily.
小猴子在树上开心地跳上跳下。
Good morning!: Good morning! Did you sleep well after the long trip?
早上好!长途旅行之后你睡得好吗?
Good afternoon!: Good afternoon, everyone! Let's start our English class now.
大家下午好!现在我们开始上英语课。
